title: Chore Balance Between Partners
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chore:completion
| search person=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",effort_points,0))) as effort by person _time
| stats avg(effort) as avg_effort by person
| sort - avg_effort
description: Compares the household workload each partner actually carries by effort points, settling the fairness debate with data.
value: Perceived chore imbalance is a common friction; an effort-weighted comparison replaces resentment with a clear picture.
implementation: Ingest chore completions with effort weights into `index=personal`; compare weekly effort by partner.
visualization: Bar chart of average weekly chore effort by partner.
grandmaExplanation: It compares how much housework each partner really does, settling the fairness question with facts.
